About NEET College Predictor 2026

NEET college predictor 2026 is a tool designed to help students find possible colleges based on their NEET score and rank, with high chances of getting medical course seats. It uses advanced algorithms to calculate the estimated possibility of getting into a college based on ranks. The NEET college predictor by marks retrieves data based on the NEET 2026 results and predicts accurate results for the given marks & rank range. By using this tool, students can find out their chances of securing seats in the 15% AIQ quota or 15% state quota based on their scores. Therefore, students eager to know more about the NEET college predictor 2026 can find out about the benefits of the NEET college predictor, prediction parameters, etc.

NEET UG College Predictor: Find Your Allotment Chances

Navigating medical admissions requires more than just simple calculation; it requires authoritative data & verified insights. Our NEET UG 2026 college predictor is engineered using a proprietary algorithm that synthesises official MCC closing ranks with current year difficulty variables. We don't just guess your ranks, but rather provide statistical probability for college admissions. 

Why Trust Our Prediction?
Expertise: Our data is compiled by analysts with 10+ years of experience in the medical counselling field. 
Experience: The real-time feedback loops in our college predictor are integrated based on the real-time response from previous years' students.
Trust: We provide 100% transperancy on data sources, including NTA & state-specific DME portals.

Details Required to Use NEET 2026 College Predictor

NEET Medical College Predictor 2026 uses specific personal information to give the most accurate results. Here are the details that are required by NEET College Predictor 2026 to anticipate the names of the potential Medical or Dental Colleges.

Estimated NEET rank, or Student's NEET 2026 All India Rank 

Name of the Student

Student's Phone Number

Student's Email ID

Student's Choice of Stream (Medical/Dental)

Student's Domicile Proof

Student's Category Certificate (General/ST/SC/OBC)

How to Use NEET College Predictor 2026

The NEET UG College Predictor free tool can be used by entering the All India Rank (AIR) of students as per the merit list, and they must also input their NEET category. Students can find ways to use the NEET 2026 college predictor mentioned below.

Fill out NEET UG Rank and Category: Students are required to submit their category and NEET(UG) AIR in the input areas of the NEET 2026 College Predictor. Enter your name, email address, phone number, state, and stream (Medical or Dental). Click on submit. 

Wait for the Predicted College's Name: The tool takes a fraction of a second to predict the name of the potential College based on your NEET rank after all the necessary data has been submitted. Then, it shows you a list of colleges that fit your choices.

Click on View Details: Students must click on "View Details" mentioned in the bottom right corner of the NEET predicted college name. Students can view important details related to the medical/dental colleges displayed by the NEET UG college predictor free.

How to Use NEET College Predictor by Marks

To use the medical college predictor based on NEET marks, students can follow the steps mentioned below. 

Step 1: Go to the NEET Rank Predictor of CollegeDekho
Step 2: Enter the no. of attempts and the number of correct attempts
Step 3: Submit and get the predicted rank.
Step 4: Go to the College Predictor NEET by CollegeDekho
Step 5: Select your category and enter the predicted rank by CollegeDekho
Step 6: Click on Submit.
NEET UG College Predictor Parameters

The NEET UG college predictor is a tool that makes use of various parameters to predict the potential college for students according to the marks secured. The major parameters that are taken into consideration while using the NEET UG College Predictor 2026 are the following:

Category of the candidate
Score of the candidate
The total number of questions answered by a candidate
Difficulty level of the examination
The total number of applicants
Previous year NEET Marks vs ranks
Accuracy of Collegedekho NEET UG College Predictor 2026: Our Methodology

To uphold justice in your NEET UG 2026 college prediction, our tool uses multi layered data verification process. The tool integrates official seat allotment data directly from MCC & various state cells. Our methodology applies a regression analysis of the last five years of data, including opening & closing rank trends, to predict your college. By cross-referencing DGHS reports with real-time counselling trends, we predict the most suitable college based on your NEET ranks or scores. 

How to Shortlist Best Institutes Using the NEET 2026 College Predictor

Students can shortlist colleges best suited for them by using the NEET college predictor free tool. To analyse which MBBS/BDS seat in the college of their choice can be opted for, students can refer to the college predictor with NEET marks as mentioned below:

Step 1: Firstly, students will have to click on the “CollegeDekho College Predictor Free Tool for NEET”
Step 2: Then, they have to enter their NEET score, location, category, and personal details into the free NEET college predictor.
Step 3: Now, wait for a few minutes and allow the NEET 2026 college predictor tool to analyse the information you provided for generating relevant results.
Step 4: These results will typically include estimated ranks and a list of colleges that may be suitable for you.
Step 5: Carefully analyse the information presented to you by the NEET College Predictor without registration, based on the estimated ranks and the list of colleges.
Step 6: Take your time to assess each college's infrastructure, reputation, faculty, and placement facilities. Also, verify if the institutions shortlisted by the tool are recognised by the Medical Council of India (MCI). 
Step 7: Shortlist colleges that best suit your predicted rank and score. Consider factors such as location, college reputation, facilities, and any specific preferences you may have.
